source_files_inspected: backend/app.py (route list, connect, cypher, ingest/event, rag/compare)
languages_frameworks: vanilla JS/HTML frontend with graph view

implemented_capabilities.capability: Dual-mode graph engine: in-process NetworkX 'Cypher emulator' with optional live FalkorDB
implemented_capabilities.notes: The 'emulator' does not parse Cypher: query() only string-matches 'RETURN n' / 'MATCH (n:Label)' and otherwise returns a node/edge count. Real algorithms (BFS blast radius treating edges as undirected, networkx pagerank/betweenness/greedy modularity) run in Python on the emulator graph. Live FalkorDB is used only for a few pass-through queries (algo.pageRank, shortestPath, one root-cause path query) and a MERGE sync; all agents/memory read and write the in-process emulator, not FalkorDB.

implemented_capabilities.capability: MCP-style tool registry over the graph
implemented_capabilities.notes: In-process class (not a protocol server). Decision lineage matches a node by substring on id/code/title and returns its adjacent edges; falkordb_execute_action returns a canned 'EXECUTED' dict with templated remediation text and performs no action.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Four-agent pipeline (Triage, Investigator, Action, Memory) with handoff nodes
implemented_capabilities.notes: Fixed sequential pipeline. Investigator branches by intent and issues fixed tool calls against hard-coded demo ids (service_payment_gw, inc_804, sarah_chen, service_auth, rfc_104); synthesis strings are literal text naming 'Sarah Chen' and 'PR #482' regardless of what the tools returned; hops_count is hard-coded 1 vs 5.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Two-run learning loop (HISTORICAL_CASCADE shortcut edge) and tri-memory
implemented_capabilities.notes: Episodes/sessions/shortcut edges are nodes in the in-memory emulator (lost on restart; /api/agents/reset_learning resets them). The claimed '80% speedup' is the scripted 5-hop vs 1-hop branch, not a measured effect.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Vector RAG vs graph comparison endpoint
implemented_capabilities.notes: Returns a literal JSON body (fake chunk ids/scores, execution_latency_ms: 1.2); no retrieval is performed.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Event ingestion (commit, Slack, ticket) and chaos injector
implemented_capabilities.notes: Adds nodes/edges into the in-memory graph from request data with defaults (author sarah_chen); not persisted to FalkorDB unless sync is called.
Formats the tool registry as function schemas for OpenAI-compatible endpoints; falls back to the scripted planner when no key is set.

graph_models_and_cypher: Per-tenant graph names tenant_<id>_brain / tenant_<id>_memory. Labels (emulator): Service, Person, PullRequest, Commit, Incident, RFC, Decision, Ticket, SlackMessage, Playbook, AgentSession, MemoryEpisode, AgentState. Edges: DEPENDS_ON, MODIFIES, AUTHORED, AFFECTS, HAS_COMMIT, DOCUMENTED_IN, MOTIVATED_BY, CONTAINS_EPISODE, REFERENCED, HAS_STATE_TRANSITION, HISTORICAL_CASCADE. Live-FalkorDB Cypher present: algo.pageRank('Service','DEPENDS_ON'), shortestPath((a {id})-[*..6]-(b {id})), and a root-cause path (Incident)-[:AFFECTS]->(Service)-[:DEPENDS_ON*1..4]->(Service)<-[:MODIFIES]-(PullRequest)<-[:AUTHORED]-(Person). shortestPath() is not guaranteed on FalkorDB 4.22 (SPpaths/algo.* is the native route) so those queries silently fall back to the emulator.
algorithms: BFS blast radius over undirected successors+predecessors with depth cap (graph_engine.py:FalkorDBLocalCypherEmulator.blast_radius) - note direction is ignored
networkx PageRank, betweenness, degree centrality, greedy modularity communities, shortest path
Scripted 'learned shortcut' edge insertion (memory_agent.py) presented as learning
backend_interfaces: FastAPI: GET /api/health; POST /api/falkordb/connect, /api/falkordb/sync; GET /api/graph/data; POST /api/graph/cypher (arbitrary Cypher passthrough); GET /api/graph/algorithms/{pagerank,centrality,communities,shortest_path,blast_radius}; POST /api/agents/chat; GET /api/agents/sessions/{id}, /api/agents/handoffs; GET /api/memory/summary and procedural playbooks; POST /api/memory/procedural/learn; GET /api/mcp/tools; POST /api/mcp/call; POST /api/ingest/event, /api/ingest/chaos, /api/agents/reset_learning; GET /api/rag/compare
agent_or_memory_mechanisms: Sequential Triage->Investigator->Action->Memory handoff with AgentState nodes; episodic/semantic/procedural managers over the in-memory emulator graph; the claimed two-run learning loop is a scripted branch keyed on is_memory_accelerated. Nothing durable unless explicitly synced to FalkorDB.
tests_present: One end-to-end smoke test (backend/tests/test_system.py::test_full_system_across_all_tracks) that seeds the emulator and asserts on scripted outputs; no unit tests and no live-FalkorDB test.
security_findings: backend/app.py:184-188 - POST /api/graph/cypher forwards arbitrary caller-supplied Cypher (and tenant/graph names) to FalkorDB with no auth or read-only guard; mcp tool falkordb_cypher_query exposes the same to the LLM

backend/app.py:46 - CORS allow_origins=['*']; no authentication on any route including /api/falkordb/connect (app.py:99-100; lets a caller repoint the engine at an arbitrary FalkorDB host:port/url - SSRF-style) and /api/mcp/call

backend/graph_engine.py:385,398 - sync_to_live_falkordb builds Cypher with f-strings from node label and relationship type taken from graph data (injection if labels/types originate from request payloads)
backend/mcp_server.py:283-300 - falkordb_execute_action reports status EXECUTED for isolate_service/page_on_call/revert_pr without doing anything (misleading audit trail)
backend/graph_engine.py:236 and backend/app.py:487 - hard-coded claims ('FalkorDB 6.0 GraphBLAS Rust Engine', 1.2 ms latency) are fabricated telemetry
No eval/exec/pickle/subprocess; no hard-coded secrets (.env.example placeholders only)
duplicates_or_overlaps: Overlaps Incident & Root Cause Analysis (blast radius + root cause path), Agent Memory & Provenance (episodic/procedural memory, decision lineage) and Enterprise Knowledge ('company brain'); same pattern as AgentAhmed/blast-radius but without the real graph persistence.
evidence_drift_relevance: LOW - decision lineage is a substring lookup plus adjacent edges in an in-memory graph; the RFC status APPROVED_ACTIVE field exists in seed data but nothing enforces supersession, temporal validity or approval gating.

strongest_reusable_unit.why: The only portable pieces are small networkx helpers and one multi-hop root-cause Cypher pattern; the rest is scripted demo narrative.
strongest_reusable_unit.external_runtime_needed: none for the networkx helpers; FalkorDB for the Cypher pattern

strategy_rationale: Core behavior runs on a networkx emulator with scripted agent outputs and fabricated claims, the real FalkorDB path is a thin optional layer, and there is no license; nothing here beats the stronger sources in the same sweep.
